$comment: Auditable exceptions for pnpm secret:scan. Every entry needs a reason and a confirmation, so a suppression is always visible in review instead of silently disappearing from the scan.

allow.reason: Committed configuration template. The value is a documented placeholder, not a credential; confirmed by the repository owner on 2026-07-28. If a real sandbox key is ever pasted here it must be rotated and replaced, and this entry removed.
Defines the detection patterns themselves. The matches are the regular expressions and their inline examples, not credentials, so the scanner would otherwise always flag its own source.

Negative-test fixtures: deliberately synthetic credentials whose only purpose is to prove detection and redaction work. Each is asserted to be detected and then redacted. No fixture may be copied from a real system.
